title: Airtight Rice Container Thickened Rice Storage Bin With Easy Open Lid For Kitchen Grain Flour Snacks Mint Green 5kg / 11lb
body_html: 1、Airtight Design: This rice container adopts efficient airtight design, effectively preventing air and bugs from entering, keeping the rice grain dry. 2、Thickened Material: The airtight rice container is made of thickened PP material, which is durable and long lasting, ensuring the safe storage of rice grains. 3、Multi Functional Storage: Not only suitable for storing rice, but also can be used to store flour, grains and other ingredients, providing more storage options. 4、Exquisite Design: This rice storage container features an exquisite design that matches any kitchen decor while taking up less space. 5、Easy To Use: The rice bin comes with an easy open and close lid for easy use and cleaning, suitable for home use and commercial kitchens.Item Type: Rice ContainerMaterial: PPColor: Mint Green1 x Rice Container1 x Measuring Cup1 x Lid  Manual measurement, please allow some errors.
